Description
App

BoardView
Renders a full 10x10 board as a grid of CellView objects, with column labels (A-J) and row labels (1-10).
CellView
A single board cell drawn entirely with JavaFX Shapes (no images), as required by the rubric (criterion 11).

Which sides of this cell connect to another part of the same ship.
DraggableShip
A ship shown in the placement tray, drawn with JavaFX shapes (criterion 11).

StartController
Controller for the start screen (nickname + New Game / Continue).
ViewManager
Centralized manager responsible for loading FXML views and swapping scenes on the primary stage.
